about: Number Quest placement item bank (Tally's Sorting Game, spec §4.3): ~250 item templates across four strands and half-grade rungs K.0–8.0. A template is a question shape with randomised numbers inside stated constraints (gen), a CCSS domain/cluster tag, the misconception its main distractor diagnoses, a response type and a reading load. Concrete items are generated by generator.js; scripts/number-quest-placement-check.js proves every template generates solvable items with correct, unique keys. Rungs are curriculum-order judgements by the writers (spec §4.3), not psychometric calibrations.
